title: Change: reservation hold goes from 24h to 48h
context:
Six weeks into the Reserve & Collect pilot, Store Operations asks to extend the hold from **24 to 48 hours**: **35% of reservations expire** before pickup, and stores have shelf space. The BU agrees. It should go live in two weeks.

Priya: *"The hold time is a back-office setting (`reservation.hold.hours`), but the store app countdown has 24h hard-coded, and so does the confirmation email text."*

modelAnswer:
**Affected:** HB-105, HB-106, HB-107, HB-130, config, PRD, FAQ, dashboard. **Not affected:** HB-104, HB-116, HB-108.

**Actions:** HB-105 → leave, link to the change · HB-106 → edit (email reads the value from config) · HB-107 → update test + add a switch-over case · HB-130 → new story (countdown reads config) · config → config ticket · FAQ and PRD → content update.

**Change note**
> **What:** The Reserve & Collect hold goes from **24h to 48h**.
> **Why:** 35% of reservations expire before pickup; stores have shelf space. Agreed with the BU and Store Operations.
> **When:** go-live on [date], 06:00, before stores open.
> **Team actions:** config ticket (hold = 48), new story for the store app countdown, update HB-106 email text (in progress), update test HB-107.
> **Open reservations at switch-over:** keep their original 24h hold (simplest, no surprises in stores). To confirm with Store Ops.
> **Others:** Store Ops briefs stores; customer service updates the FAQ; data annotates the "expired %" dashboard so the drop isn't misread.
> **Docs:** decision log entry and PRD updated today.
commonMistakes: Only changing the config and forgetting the hard-coded app and email text
Forgetting test cases, customer service and the dashboard
Not deciding what happens to reservations made before the switch
